verdict.rationale: Atlas is a company-formation service with dashboard workflows for SAFEs, equity and documents, so a bulk-operations capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no user-facing bulk or batch action across many items. Atlas filing 83(b) elections for all founders is a service it performs on the user's behalf, not a bulk operation the user can run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
